extraction_issues.description: The local packet and landed asset manifest contain no supplementary files; activity repair used XML/PDF text and OA package figures only.
Figure 5c supports 229E-HR2P live HCoV-229E inhibition in A549 cells with IC50 1.72 µM, but no linked DBAASP assay row for this exact value is present in the packet snapshot.

source_curation_notes: Rows are grounded in Results sections 2.3-2.5, Methods 4.5-4.9, and Figures 4-6 from the local OA package/PDF/XML.
Figure labels were used for exact IC50 values where the Results text rounded the same values.
No MIC/antibacterial rows were fabricated; this paper reports antiviral fusion/infection assays and mammalian cytotoxicity assays for coronavirus-derived peptides.
